datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Guatemala on a monthly basis (February, June, October 2016). Raw classifications were spatially referenced and compiled into geographic datasets (GeoJSON/KML) representing food insecurity phases by administrative unit. The IPC framework integrates multiple livelihood and food security indicators to classify populations into food insecurity phases, serving as a loss/impact dataset for humanitarian response planning.
